items.name: Carrot Cumin Paratha
steps: Combine the whole-wheat flour, ajwain, rock salt, and carrot, finely grated, additional cumin seeds.
Add the water gradually and knead a soft dough; cover and rest for 15 minutes.
Divide the dough into equal portions and roll or pat each one evenly.
Cook on a hot griddle, turning until both faces are set and dotted with brown spots.
Brush lightly with the ghee and serve while flexible and warm.
items.guidance: Carrot Cumin Paratha is a freshly griddled bread with a modest amount of finishing fat. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Besan Carrot Chilla

Serve immediately while the center remains tender.
